channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Relatório final da PEC da aposentadoria compulsória 'é uma vacina' contra demora para afastar magistrado, diz Eliziane Gama
item.description: Senator Eliziane Gama (PT-MA), rapporteur of the PEC that abolishes compulsory retirement as punishment for judges, described the final report of the proposal as 'a vaccine' against delays in removing magistrates involved in disciplinary infractions. The PEC, proposed by Flávio Dino in February 2024, replaces compulsory retirement with stricter sanctions such as removal from office, and already has support from a March 2024 STF decision that ordered the CNJ to apply this penalty as the maximum disciplinary sanction. The vote in the Senate’s CCJ is scheduled for Wednesday (8).

item.title: SP e RJ têm os menores índices de eleitores adolescentes do país; Nordeste e Norte têm os maiores
item.description: São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro have the lowest percentages of adolescent voters in the country, at 11.7% and 11.3% respectively, well below the national average of 20.3%. In contrast, Northern and Northeastern states lead in youth participation, with Rondônia at the top (40.5%), followed by Tocantins, Piauí, Maranhão, Ceará, and Amapá, all above 30%. UNICEF and the TSE launched a national campaign to encourage youth voter registration before the May 6 deadline.

item.title: PT determina apoio a Juliana Brizola e partido não terá candidato ao governo do RS pela primeira vez
item.description: The national leadership of the Workers' Party (PT) has decided to support Juliana Brizola (PDT) as the pre-candidate for governor of Rio Grande do Sul in 2026, marking the first time the party will not field its own candidate in the state. The decision, made by the Electoral Working Group (GTE), calls for building a joint electoral strategy with the PDT and other democratic forces under Brizola’s leadership, while designating Edegar Pretto as the most legitimate figure to lead the coordination — despite Pretto’s insistence on continuing his own pre-campaign.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro troca de candidato a vaga no TCU e pode ajudar petista
item.description: The PL replaced Hélio Lopes with Soraya Santos in the TCU race following coordination by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro. The shift may fragment opposition votes and benefit the Workers' Party candidate Odair Cunha, who stands to gain from the division among non-government forces.

item.title: Governo Lula avança em nova regra contra conteúdo misógino on-line
item.description: The Lula government is advancing a new decree from the Ministry of Justice to combat online gender-based violence, focusing on immediate removal of illicit content by platforms, accelerated reporting for victims, and holding companies accountable for coordinated attacks and non-consensual AI-generated deepfakes. The measure is part of the National Pact Brazil Without Femicide and is being coordinated with the Ministries of Women and Secom, currently under review at the Civil House.

item.title: Aécio tenta articular outra candidatura de terceira via contra Lula e Flávio
item.description: Aécio Neves, national president of the PSDB, says he is still working to build a third-way candidacy against Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, having already met with Michel Temer and Ciro Gomes. He emphasizes that the PSDB will not align with either side of the polarization and projects the party will elect between 35 and 40 federal deputies in 2026.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro ainda busca marqueteiro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro sought Paulo Vasconcellos as his campaign strategist for 2026, but Vasconcellos chose to remain with Ronaldo Caiado's team. The information was released in a subscriber-only article requiring registration for full access.

item.title: Financial Times diz que Bolsonaros estavam ‘politicamente acabados’ mas retornaram fortes com Flávio
item.description: The Financial Times states that the Bolsonaro family was 'politically finished', but has made a strong comeback through the presidential pre-candidacy of Flávio Bolsonaro in 2026. The newspaper highlights that Flavio presents a less aggressive image than his father while maintaining far-right positions on security and social issues, proposing measures such as lowering the criminal age to 14 and mass incarceration inspired by Bukele. His economic plan is described as vague, focused on tax cuts and privatizations—including Correios—while his involvement in the 'rachadinhas' scandal is noted as a negative factor.

item.title: Entenda o pacote do governo Lula para conter alta dos preços de combustíveis
item.description: The Lula government announced a package of measures to curb fuel price increases, including a R$1.20 per liter subsidy for imported road diesel (half funded by adhering states), elimination of PIS and Cofins on aviation kerosene and biodiesel, and mechanisms to smooth international price fluctuations. The Provisional Measure also authorizes subsidies for domestic diesel producers and LPG imports, and strengthens ANP’s oversight to prevent abusive pricing. 25 states have already joined the initiative.

item.title: PGR defende eleição direta para governador-tampão do Rio de Janeiro
item.description: The Attorney General's Office advocated for a direct election to fill the interim governorship of Rio de Janeiro, stating that the vacancy resulted from an electoral cassation, not a mere resignation, and that, under electoral law, direct elections are required when a vacancy occurs more than six months before the end of the term. The opinion was submitted to the Supreme Federal Court, which is reviewing a PSD challenge to the TSE’s decision mandating an indirect vote by the state legislature. The Court is set to resume deliberations in an in-person session on Wednesday, April 8, following a spotlight request by Minister Cristiano Zanin.

item.title: Governo Lula assina protocolo de investigação a crimes contra jornalistas
item.description: The Lula government signed the National Protocol for the Investigation of Crimes Against Journalists and Communicators, focusing on immediate victim protection, qualified investigation, evidence preservation, and victim-centered listening. The initiative includes inter-ministerial coordination and plans a specific decree for gender-based online violence against women journalists, linked to the Brazil Pact to Femicide. The protocol was framed as a response to the 2022 murder of British journalist Dom Phillips in the Amazon.

item.title: Demissão na cúpula da Petrobras expõe pressão de Lula para aparelhar politicamente estatal
item.description: Petrobras dismissed Logistics, Commercialization and Markets Director Claudio Romeo Schlosser after fuel and gas auctions deemed technically necessary by the company were labeled 'banditry' and 'stupidity' by President Lula due to LPG and fuel price hikes. Lula is pressuring the state-owned enterprise to meet electoral demands, particularly from voters reliant on cheap cooking gas, despite polls showing populist spending fails to convert into votes. The dismissal signals political interference in Petrobras for re-election purposes, undermining its technical autonomy.

item.title: ACM Neto soma 47,3% e lidera a disputa pelo Governo da Bahia
item.description: ACM Neto leads the Bahia gubernatorial race with 47.3% voting intentions, followed by incumbent governor Jerônimo Rodrigues at 30.9%, according to a Veritá Institute survey. Rejection rates are highest for Jerônimo (46.9%) and ACM Neto at 21.5%. The poll, registered with the TSE under code BA-02245/2026, surveyed 2,020 people between March 18–24, 2026.

item.title: Allan dos Santos chama Nikolas Ferreira de “Analfabeto e mau carater”
item.description: Allan dos Santos, a fugitive journalist and Bolsonaro ally, attacked federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) on X, calling him 'illiterate' and 'of bad character' after Ferreira defended his support for Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential pre-candidacy and used language deemed misogynistic. The criticism followed backlash over Ferreira's suggestion that a female user was menstruating. Dos Santos has lived in the U.S. since 2020, is a fugitive from Brazilian justice on charges including insult and incitement, and denies persecution claims.

item.title: Tarcísio apoia PEC de Flávio Bolsonaro e diz que reeleição 'está fazendo mal para o Brasil'
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas expressed support for a PEC proposed by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro to abolish re-election in Brazil, arguing the current system encourages a 'permanent election state' and harms governance. He stated the proposal aims to restore the pre-1997 single-term model and noted the PL is advancing in internal discussions to determine the candidate for São Paulo’s second Senate seat, following the allocation of the first seat to Guilherme Derrite (PP).

item.title: Entra em vigor a lei institui o Estatuto dos Direitos do Paciente
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva signed into law, without vetoes, Law 15.378/26, establishing the Patient Rights Statute, which guarantees comprehensive protections for users of health services in both public and private sectors. The law ensures rights such as access to medical records, informed consent, presence of companions, choice of place of death, confidentiality, and non-discrimination, while also assigning the State the duty to disseminate and monitor compliance.

item.title: Mobilização indígena em Brasília cobra Lula, critica Congresso e expõe impasse nas demarcações
item.description: The 2026 Terra Libre Camp in Brasília gathers thousands of indigenous people to pressure the Lula government to accelerate land demarcation and criticize the National Congress as 'enemy of the peoples'. While acknowledging some progress, leaders denounce slowness and vow direct pressure for concrete results.

item.title: Temer elogia Augusto Cury, mas evita falar em apoio do MDB a ele
item.description: Michel Temer praised writer Augusto Cury as 'an extraordinary name' and confirmed they discussed a potential candidacy, but avoided declaring MDB's support for Cury, stating the party should decide independently. He also commented on political radicalization in Brazil, advocating for pacification and semi-presidentialism, and mentioned Ronaldo Caiado as a pre-candidate who will face the challenge of overcoming societal divisions.

item.title: De Jânio Quadros a Obama: o que é o Podemos, a sigla que mais cresceu na janela partidária
item.description: Podemos, a party founded in 1995 and led by the Abreu family, grew 69% during the 2026 party-switching window, increasing from 16 to 27 deputies in the Chamber and becoming the eighth-largest caucus. Though historically linked to Jânio Quadros’ PTN, the party has supported candidates across the spectrum — including Ciro Gomes, Lula, Dilma Rousseff, and Aécio Neves — reflecting a pragmatic, centrist alignment strategy.

item.title: PSDB fará limpa em aliados de Eduardo Leite no diretório tucano no RS, diz Aécio
item.description: The PSDB, led by Aécio Neves, is planning a reconfiguration in Rio Grande do Sul following Governor Eduardo Leite’s departure to the PSD, removing Leite’s allies from key positions and appointing Porto Alegre city councilman Moisés Barboza as the new state party president. The party will support former Guaíba mayor Marcelo Maranata as its gubernatorial candidate against Leite’s PSD faction, aiming to elect up to three federal deputies in 2026. Aécio criticized Leite for sacrificing greater influence in the PSDB to become dependent on a single figure in the PSD.

item.title: Flávio diz que Tarcísio seria candidato mais 'preparado': 'Preferiria votar em você do que em mim'
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated that Tarcísio de Freitas is more prepared for the presidency than himself, praising their close relationship and noting Tarcísio was the first person he consulted after being chosen by Jair Bolsonaro for the presidential race. He also discussed his efforts to mediate internal conflicts within Bolsonarism, particularly with Eduardo Bolsonaro, and sought to balance alliances with Nikolas Ferreira, emphasizing the need for unity and coordination on the right to make his 2026 candidacy viable.

item.title: Procuradoria Eleitoral quer eleições diretas para mandato tampão no RJ
item.description: Electoral Deputy Prosecutor Alexandre Espinosa Bravo Barbosa argued that the special election to fill the vacant governorship of Rio de Janeiro, following Cláudio Castro's resignation, must be held by direct vote, as the vacancy resulted from an electoral cause (TSE conviction for abuse of power) and occurred more than six months before the end of the term. He stated Castro's resignation, one day before his TSE condemnation, was an attempt to evade electoral justice, and TSE jurisprudence mandates direct elections in cases of dual vacancy due to electoral causes with over six months left in the term. The STF will rule on the matter on April 8, 2026.

item.title: André Marinho declara apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Comedian and Rio de Janeiro gubernatorial pré-candidate for the Novo party, André Marinho, declared his support for Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL) presidential pré-candidacy. He noted that they had been together since 2018 in a movement that 'shook the country,' recalling how their political alliance began in his home. The endorsement was originally published on O Antagonista.

item.title: A declaração de Flávio que revelou um bastidor e uma estratégia do clã Bolsonaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro revealed that, upon being chosen by Jair Bolsonaro as the presidential candidate, he approached São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas and acknowledged his superior preparedness for the presidency, stating Tarcísio was 'much more prepared'. The disclosure exposes a family-driven strategy within the Bolsonaro clan, where Flávio's candidacy serves to maintain influence and rehabilitate Jair Bolsonaro’s political standing, rather than selecting the most electable candidate. This implies Tarcísio was sacrificed in favor of familial control, highlighting a tension between electoral viability and internal loyalty.

item.title: As apostas da Assembleia do Rio sobre a influência do STF na eleição para substituir Bacellar
item.description: The STF's upcoming decision on the Rio de Janeiro gubernatorial election may influence the vote for the presidency of the State Legislative Assembly, as the opposition pushes for secret voting to prevent coercion and undue influence from the Executive and organized crime. The governing base (PL, PP, União) argues that judicial intervention would violate legislative autonomy and the internal rules mandating open votes. The PDT has filed a lawsuit requesting secret ballots due to fears of political persecution, with deputies like Rosenverg Reis (MDB) supporting the move and Rodrigo Amorim (União) opposing it.

item.title: Governo atualiza teto de indenização diária de transporte de servidores de R$ 17 para R$ 82,36
item.description: The Lula government updated the daily transportation allowance cap for federal public servants using personal vehicles for official duties, raising it from R$17 to R$82.36 based on 384.45% cumulative inflation from October 1999 to March 2026. The decree, published in an extra edition of the DOU, takes effect immediately and applies only to the federal Executive branch as a non-remunerative reimbursement.

item.title: Flávio se reúne com deputada do PP citada como possível vice
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL’s pre-candidate for president, met in São Paulo with federal deputy Simone Marquetto (PP), who recently switched from MDB to the PP. The meeting was seen as a strategic move to strengthen ties with the Progressistas party, aiming to shape a presidential ticket for 2026.

item.title: Se Caiado tiver 15% dos votos ‘está ótimo’, diz Kassab
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, president of the PSD, said that if Ronaldo Caiado's presidential pre-candidacy reaches 15% of the vote, it would be 'great,' even if it doesn't make it to the runoff. He emphasized that the 'third way' is important for Brazil to show there is an alternative to Lula and Bolsonaro, both of whom have rejection rates above 40%. Kassab believes Caiado can reach 10% by the end of June, when party conventions occur, and considers this goal feasible due to voter fluidity.

item.title: Endividamento das famílias vai a 80,4% em março e bate recorde
item.description: Brazilian household debt reached a historic high of 80.4% in March, up 0.2 percentage points from February, according to the CNC. The Lula government is studying a relaunch of the Desenrola Brasil program to renegotiate debts with discounts, while the CNC warns that debt levels will likely continue rising until monetary policy easing takes full effect on consumers.

item.title: ‘Bolsonaro’s comeback’: após baque, clã ensaia volta ao poder no Brasil, diz ‘Financial Times’
item.description: The Financial Times highlights the potential political comeback of the Bolsonaro clan, with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro emerging as a competitive candidate against Lula in the 2026 elections, despite his father’s imprisonment and brother’s self-imposed exile. He positions himself as a younger, more moderate alternative while maintaining a platform aligned with his father’s far-right views on social issues and crime, paired with center-right economic stances. The article notes his rise signals a renewed polarized clash between right and left, with high rejection rates for both main contenders.

item.title: Estatuto do Paciente: veja os novos direitos garantidos por lei
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva signed Law 15.378/2026, establishing the Patient's Statute, which guarantees autonomy, informed consent, right to refuse treatment, appointment of a healthcare representative, palliative care, and protection against discrimination in healthcare services.

item.title: PGR defende eleições diretas para governador do Rio de Janeiro
item.description: The Attorney General's Office (PGR) advocated for direct elections to choose Rio de Janeiro's governor following the resignation of Cláudio Castro, who became ineligible for eight years due to 2022 electoral irregularities. The Supreme Federal Court (STF) will rule on the matter this Wednesday, deciding whether the succession will be by popular vote or indirectly via the state Legislative Assembly. Castro's resignation came after the TSE signaled his impeachment, involving abuse of economic and political power.

item.title: Ao Financial Times, Flávio Bolsonaro diz que Lula trata o Brasil como 'colônia chinesa'
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro accused the Lula government of treating Brazil as a 'Chinese colony' in an interview with the Financial Times, criticating Lula's alleged hostility toward the United States and advocating for a strategic alliance with Washington to export critical minerals. He positioned himself as a competitive presidential candidate for 2026, calling for a younger, more modern government, while attempting to distance himself from his father by publicly taking the Covid-19 vaccine.

item.title: Sancionado, Estatuto dos Direitos do Paciente entra em vigor
item.description: The Patient Rights Statute, enacted under Law 15.378/2026 and published in the Official Gazette on April 7, has come into force, guaranteeing rights such as autonomy in treatment decisions, access to medical records, second opinions, privacy, palliative care, and respect for dignity, preferred name, and cultural characteristics. It also defines patient responsibilities, including providing accurate health information and following medical guidance, and establishes mechanisms for investigating complaints.

item.title: La Guaira x Fluminense: saiba onde assistir ao jogo da Libertadores
item.description: Fluminense debuts in the 2026 Copa Libertadores against Deportivo La Guaira in Venezuela at 7:00 PM (Brasília time), Group C match. The Tricolor, 2023 champions, return to the tournament after a one-year absence, aiming to build on good form, while the Venezuelan side comes off a 10-match unbeaten streak. The game will be streamed exclusively on Paramount+.

item.title: Petrobras anuncia Guilherme Mello no Conselho de Administração
item.description: Petrobras announced Guilherme Mello, Secretary of Economic Policy at the Ministry of Finance, to join and preside over its Board of Directors, with approval expected at the April 16, 2026 Ordinary General Assembly. Mello, nominated by Fernando Haddad and endorsed by Lula, is leaving the Finance Ministry to become executive secretary of the Planning Ministry and already presides over BNDES, raising market concerns over his perceived tolerance for high inflation and economic stimulus.

item.title: Quem era o único petista em evento de homenagem a André Mendonça em SP
item.description: The homage event for Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça, held at the São Paulo Legislative Assembly, was attended by Bolsonaro-aligned authorities and only one PT deputy: Emídio de Souza, coordinator of Fernando Haddad’s government plan. Mendonça, appointed by Bolsonaro, delivered a 20-minute speech on judicial impartiality, avoiding direct mention of the investigations into Lulinha, Lula’s son, for which he had authorized the breaking of bank, fiscal, and telephonic seals.

item.title: PGR se manifesta a favor de eleições diretas para cargo de governador no Rio de Janeiro
item.description: The Attorney General's Office (PGR) has advocated for a direct election to choose Rio de Janeiro's next governor, arguing that Claudio Castro's conviction for abuse of power — though not finalized due to his resignation — created a vacancy that makes an indirect election by the state legislature incompatible. The PGR's statement comes one day before the Supreme Federal Court (STF) rules on two actions determining whether the succession will be indirect (via state legislators) or direct (via popular vote), with the government currently led interim by TJ-RJ President Ricardo Couto following Castro's resignation on March 23.

item.title: PGR defende eleições diretas no Rio de Janeiro
item.description: Deputy Electoral Attorney General Alexandre Espinosa Bravo Barbosa urged the STF to hold direct elections for Rio de Janeiro's governorship, arguing that the vacancies of governor and vice-governor stem from the TSE's annulment of the diplomas of Cláudio Castro and Thiago Pampolha due to abuse of power. He contends that because the vacancy is of electoral origin, the Electoral Code must apply, mandating a new direct election, contrary to the TSE's indirect election decision. The STF will rule on Wednesday (April 8) on two consolidated actions determining Rio's succession model, with Judge Ricardo Couto de Castro currently serving as interim governor per Justice Cristiano Zanin's order.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro questiona ‘condições psiquiátricas’ de pré-candidato do Missão
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro questioned the psychiatric fitness of Renan Santos, a presidential pre-candidate from the Missão party, stating he 'has no psychiatric conditions to govern anything' after seeing him protest with a sword and a purple lollipop. The senator also said he plans to pursue legal action against Renan for defamation, referencing a ongoing exchange of insults since 2025, including accusations that Bolsonaro 'returned Lula to power' and that Renan wants to 'end his race'.

item.title: Ex-governadores petistas rejeitam ceder vaga a Juliana Brizola no RS: 'Aqui ninguém aceita intervenção'
item.description: Former PT governors of Rio Grande do Sul, Tarso Genro and Olívio Dutra, rejected the possibility of national PT intervention in the pre-candidacy of Edegar Pretto, defending the local choice as democratic and legitimate. They stated that replacing Pretto with Juliana Brizola (PDT) would be a disrespect to the party's history and grassroots militancy, reinforcing support for the alliance with PSOL, PCdoB, PV, Rede and PSB.

item.title: Pix: quem fala mal do sistema de pagamento não defende os brasileiros, diz diretor do BC
item.description: Banco Central director Paulo Picchetti defended Pix at an FGV event in Rio, stating that critics of the system have interests not aligned with the Brazilian population. He emphasized that Pix is free, instant, and sovereign, reinforcing the government Lula’s stance that "Pix is Brazil’s". The remarks come amid U.S. claims that Pix unfairly disadvantages American credit card companies like Visa and Mastercard.

item.title: PGR defende eleição direta para cargo de governador do Rio
item.description: The Attorney General of the Republic, Paulo Gonet, advocated for a direct election to choose the governor of Rio de Janeiro following the resignation of Cláudio Castro, stating that the vacancy has an electoral nature and occurred more than six months before the end of the term. Gonet emphasized that, according to TSE guidance, a direct election must be held when dual vacancies arise from electoral causes with over six months remaining in the mandate. The opinion was submitted to the Supreme Federal Court one day before the ruling on the matter.

item.title: Nova lei muda regra para audiência de retratação em caso de violência doméstica
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva signed Law 15.380/26, amending the Maria da Penha Law to require the victim's express consent before a retraction hearing in domestic violence cases. The new rule ensures that withdrawal of the complaint occurs only by the victim's free will, with oral or written statements recorded in the case file. The law originated from Bill 3112/23 by Deputy Laura Carneiro (PSD-RJ), approved by Congress.

item.title: Nova lei inclui a imunoterapia em protocolos de tratamento do câncer
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva signed Law 15.379/26, which includes immunotherapy in cancer treatment protocols within the SUS, expanding access beyond the private sector. The law amends the Organic Health Law and was approved by Congress in 2024, originating from Bill 2371/21 by Deputy Bibo Nunes (PL-RS). Although immunotherapy is more costly, it is considered economically advantageous in cases of higher efficacy due to increased disease-free survival and reduced recurrence rates.

item.title: CPI do Crime Organizado cobra de Alcolumbre andamento da PEC da Segurança
item.description: The president of the Organized Crime CPI, Senator Fabiano Contarato (PT-SE), urged Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (União Brasil-AP) to advance the Public Security PEC, already approved by the Chamber of Deputies and stalled in the Senate for over a month. The proposal includes allocating part of sports betting companies' profits to public security. Contarato emphasized the issue's importance and made a public appeal for Alcolumbre to forward the PEC for processing.

item.title: Ibovespa abre em alta, mas tensão no Estreito de Ormuz e ultimato dos EUA elevam cautela
item.description: The Ibovespa opened higher at 186,853 points, but markets remain cautious due to the U.S. ultimatum for the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz and stalled negotiations with Iran. In Brazil, Aneel is reviewing a possible termination of Enel São Paulo’s concession contract, while President Lula meets with ministers of Finance, Labor, and Planning. Major bank stocks are declining, led by Banco do Brasil (-1.11%).

item.title: Meio-Dia em Brasília: Lula lança pacote bilionário contra alta dos combustíveis
item.description: President Lula announced a billion-dollar package of measures to curb rising fuel prices in response to increasing global oil prices. The announcement was made during the Meio-Dia em Brasília program on Tuesday, the 7th, and includes tax reductions and state support for fuel distributors. The program also covered a public hearing in the Constitution and Justice Committee regarding the potential end of the 6×1 work schedule.

item.title: A alta do preço do gás de cozinha em ano eleitoral — uma comparação de Lula e FHC
item.description: The rise in cooking gas prices during an election year puts President Lula in a situation similar to that faced by Fernando Henrique Cardoso in 2002. Both instances involve cost-of-living pressures during electoral campaigns, with cooking gas being a sensitive item for low-income families. The article compares the two scenarios as a test of economic management in an electoral context.

item.title: Conheça Márcio Elias Rosa, novo ministro do MDIC
item.description: Márcio Fernando Elias Rosa, 63, assumed the role of Minister of Development, Industry, Commerce and Services (MDIC) on April 6, replacing Geraldo Alckmin, who is leaving the government to run for vice president on Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s ticket. Rosa is a long-time ally of Alckmin, having held key positions in São Paulo’s administration under his leadership, including state prosecutor general and secretary of Justice and Citizenship Defense. He was part of Lula’s 2022 transition team and served as Executive Secretary of the MDIC before his appointment as minister.
